hero.sub: From certified trainers to training buddies — meet real people near you, match on activity and pace, and train together in person.

items.title: Discover
items.body: Browse companions near you, filtered by activity, tier, and price. Every profile shows distance, rating, and what they actually do.

items.title: Book
items.body: Request a session — pick the offering, time, and place. They accept, you meet. Reschedule or cancel anytime, no awkwardness.

items.title: Train
items.body: Show up and train together in person. Rate each other afterwards so the community stays strong and accountable.

tiers.intro: Whether you need a coach, a sparring partner, or just someone to keep you honest — there's a tier and a price that fits.

items.name: Certified Pros
items.blurb: Licensed, verified trainers for structured, goal-driven coaching.

items.name: Experienced Peers
items.blurb: Seasoned athletes who train alongside you and share what works.

items.name: Training Buddies
items.blurb: Someone to show up with. Low-stakes accountability to build the habit.

safety.intro: Meeting strangers to work out should feel safe by default. Safety isn't a setting in Pacergo — it's wired into every booking.

items.title: Verified profiles
items.body: Tier-A pros submit credentials to a private review before they can list. You always know who you're meeting.

items.title: Report & block
items.body: One tap to report or block. Blocks are enforced both ways — blocked users disappear from each other's discovery entirely.

items.title: Share your session
items.body: Send session details — who, where, when — to a trusted contact before you head out, straight from the app.

items.title: Meet in public
items.body: A built-in safety center with first-meet guidance and public-venue suggestions keeps early sessions low-risk.

cta.sub: Join the waitlist and be first to train with a companion when Pacergo opens in your city.
